# phase-067 — Give the session a memory: `.checkpoint`, `.restore`, `.undo`, `.redo`, `.sessions`

## You must change `src/`

This phase declares `must_touch: [src/]`. The gate fails the phase unless at
least one changed file falls under it. Writing tests, documentation or a report
is not enough — if you finish without touching that area, the phase fails on
exactly that check.


## Evidence — verified finding

```
Session state has exactly one granularity — everything (`:save`/`:restore` whole-session files, mod.rs:594-633) or nothing — and `checkpoint`, `restore`, `undo`, `redo` and `sessions` are all absent from commands.rs (verified; the `:restore` hit is the file command, a different feature). So there is no way to try something destructive and step back: a `set` that clobbers a binding, an import that shadows, a 200-line paste that half-fails — all permanent until `:reset` wipes everything. Ipp ships `.checkpoint`/`.restore` (environment snapshots), `.undo`/`.redo` (single-step), and `.sessions` (listing) as one family; redblue needs the family, named to never collide with the file commands.
```

**Re-verify this before you change anything.** If the finding no longer
reproduces on `main`, stop and write that to `FINDINGS.md` — a stale phase must
never be "fixed" by inventing a change.

## Goal

Add named in-memory snapshots (`.checkpoint <name>`, `.restore <name>`, `.sessions` listing them) plus single-step `.undo`/`.redo` over binding changes. Snapshots capture bindings, last-result and history position; they are session-local (never files, never committed) and die with the session. Names colliding with file-restore semantics are refused by the help text, which states the file/memory split once.

## Method

1. Read `AGENTS.md` in full. Obey every hard rule; they are not negotiable.
2. Reproduce the finding. Record the exact command and the exact wrong output.
3. Write the failing test FIRST. Watch it fail. Do not touch production code
   until you have a red test that fails for the right reason.
4. Make the smallest change that turns it green.
5. Run the four gates yourself before claiming anything:

   ```bash
   cargo fmt --all -- --check
   cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings
   cargo test --all-targets
   ./rbops/verify.sh phase-067
   ```

6. Write `REPORT.md` in the exact shape required by `AGENTS.md` section 4.

## Definition of done

- [ ] `.checkpoint a`, clobber a binding, `.restore a` brings the old value back exactly (asserted on the value, and on `_` last-result too — the snapshot is the whole state, not just the map)
- [ ] `.undo` after one `set` removes exactly that binding and `.redo` brings it back; `.undo` with an empty undo stack is a named empty, never a panic
- [ ] `.sessions` lists checkpoint names in creation order with the current one marked; with no checkpoints it says so rather than printing a blank table
- [ ] `:save`/`:restore` file semantics are untouched (the existing save/restore tests pass unmodified) and the help text states the file-vs-memory split in one sentence (asserted by a help-text test)
- [ ] edge_* tests cover `.restore` of an unknown name, `.checkpoint` with a duplicate name (refused, old one kept — never silent overwrite), undo across 50 bindings (stack bounded, oldest dropped with a notice, never unbounded growth), and `.redo` after a new change (redo stack cleared, stated in the message)
